summary: Welcome page capability matrix responsiveness bug fix VERIFIED. Tested across 6 breakpoints (phone 390px, phone 430px, mid 540px, mid 700px, tablet 768px, desktop 1280px). The fix correctly implements stacked single-column layout below tablet widths, preventing the cramped two-column card layout that caused letter-by-letter text collapse. All card titles (AI Writer, AI Chatbot, AI Search) remain fully readable at all widths. No horizontal overflow detected. Tablet/desktop layouts maintain proper 2-column and 3-column grids respectively.
critical_code_review_comments: WelcomeCapabilityMatrix.tsx line 61-65: webGridColumns correctly uses 'minmax(0, 1fr)' for single-column on non-tablet/desktop, 'repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))' for tablet/desktop, and 'repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr))' for roomyDesktop
Card width constraints (minWidth: 0, maxWidth: '100%') in card style prevent cramped layouts
denseMobile prop (width < 430) correctly adjusts padding and font sizes for compact phone displays
